44 unchanged paragraphs, under In short, One: the ultimate insider, Two: the infrastructure that cannot hold them…

• **Write down what the agent can reach, what it is for, the gap, and what stands in the way.** That is RiskMandate's [Agent Behaviour Policy](https://riskmandate.ai/abp.html): grant measured, mandate elicited, delta derived, barrier recorded, with each barrier typed honestly as a boundary, a setting, an expectation or nothing. Only a boundary is a control. Most of what we call controls today are expectations, and saying so is the first useful act. (RiskMandate now calls the grant the reach and the delta the gap. A later article proposes adding [footprint and blast radius](../../../articles/footprint-and-blast-radius.md): what the agent actually did, and what it would have cost. That proposal is still under review.)

28 unchanged paragraphs, under How this might become a talk, Sources
